headline: BI Prepares Himbara to Become Renminbi Clearing Bank, Here's the Leak!
summary: Himbara state-owned banks will be involved as renminbi clearing banks for direct transactions, according to a report on Bank Indonesia's preparations.
why: Clearing banks process currency payments, and renminbi clearing supports trade settlement without relying on the US dollar.
original_headline: BI Siapkan Himbara Jadi Bank Kliring Renminbi, Ini Bocorannya!
